notes.title: Version 0.31
notes.content: [h1]CAMPAIGNS[/h1][p]This patch is about upping the difficulty. Last patch, the early levels were too easy, so it wasn't necessary to try to pick a good build or aim well. For that reason, the chill difficulty without a timer has been removed.[/p][h2]New difficulty levels[/h2][list][*][p]Lite[/p][/*][*][p]Hardcore[/p][/*][*][p]Maximum[/p][/*][/list][h1]MISS LIMIT[/h1][p]Added a miss counter that has a default limit of 10. Miss too many times and you'll get a game over.[/p][h1]OBJECTIVES[/h1][p]Completion of level objectives now reduce the price of random upgrades.[/p][h1]METAPROGRESSION[/h1][list][*][p]There is a now a meta upgrade to increase the campaign time limit.[/p][/*][*][p]Meta upgrades base price is now $0 instead of $10[/p][/*][/list][h1]UPGRADES[/h1][list][*][p]Removed ball limit upgrade.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a ball limit prestige mechanic that increases the ball limit by 10 each time you reset.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a miss limit upgrade that increases the miss limit and resets the current misses.[/p][/*][/list]
